narrative.headline: Dataset quality score improved to an average of 97.7 out of 100, but sample size remains critically low for training an image classifier.
narrative.executive_summary: The shapes_survey.zip dataset contains 38 images and 37 rows after cleaning, achieving an average data quality score of 97.7 out of 100 across types. While image quality is high at 99.7 out of 100 with consistent RGB mode and 128.0 pixel width, table quality is lower at 95.7 out of 100. Critical risks include an extremely small sample size of 37 rows and 38 images leading to a high risk of overfitting, 3 rows with label disagreements between the table and folder structure, and missing images referenced by table rows. Additionally, class distribution shows 17 circle, 11 square, and 9 triangle instances in the table.
next_steps: Resolve the 3 table rows referencing missing image files and the 4 unreferenced image files in the directory.
Fix the 3 label disagreements between the table annotations and folder names.
Address potential data leakage caused by multiple table rows referencing the same image file.
Collect additional data to mitigate the high risk of overfitting caused by the small sample size of 37 rows and 38 images.
